I am a woman farming a small rented wheat plot here in Tigray. The land is not mine, so I must be careful with what I spend, but wheat needs some fertilizer to give a decent harvest in our highlands. I will try to get a little DAP and urea from the cooperative if it arrives in time, and add some manure from our animals. We have no irrigation here, so I depend on the meher rains, and my family will do most of the work ourselves.
